Every R function used in this workbook, organized by task. Use this as a lookup table when you're working on assignments.

## Importing Data

| Function | Package | What It Does | Example |
|----------|---------|-------------|---------|
| `read_csv()` | tidyverse | Imports a CSV file into R | `df <- read_csv("data.csv")` |
| `read_rds()` | tidyverse | Loads a saved .RDS file | `df <- read_rds("data.RDS")` |
| `clean_names()` | janitor | Converts column names to lowercase_with_underscores | `df <- df %>% clean_names()` |
| `clean_dates()` | v2v | Turns epoch milliseconds into a date-time, dividing by 1,000 for you | `mutate(ts = clean_dates(date))` |

## Exploring Data

| Function | Package | What It Does | Example |
|----------|---------|-------------|---------|
| `glimpse()` | tidyverse | Shows every column with data type and preview | `glimpse(df)` |
| `summary()` | base R | Summary statistics for all columns | `summary(df)` |
| `dim()` | base R | Number of rows and columns | `dim(df)` |
| `names()` | base R | List column names | `names(df)` |
| `nrow()` | base R | Count rows | `nrow(df)` |
| `head()` | base R | Show first 6 rows | `head(df)` |

## Cleaning Data

| Function | Package | What It Does | Example |
|----------|---------|-------------|---------|
| `distinct()` | tidyverse | Remove duplicate rows | `df %>% distinct()` |
| `filter()` | tidyverse | Keep rows matching a condition | `df %>% filter(age > 18)` |
| `mutate()` | tidyverse | Create or modify columns | `df %>% mutate(new = old * 2)` |
| `case_when()` | tidyverse | Recode values with if/then logic | `case_when(x == 1 ~ "yes", TRUE ~ "no")` |
| `str_to_lower()` | tidyverse | Convert text to lowercase | `str_to_lower("POP")` → `"pop"` |
| `is.na()` | base R | Check for missing values | `filter(!is.na(column))` |
| `join_chat_streams()` | v2v | Attaches each message's nearest earlier stream snapshot (a rolling join) | `join_chat_streams(chat, streams)` |
| `reliability()` | v2v | Cohen's kappa or Krippendorff's alpha from two columns of codes | `reliability(pull(pilot, pass_1), pull(pilot, pass_2), method = "kappa")` |
| `factor()` | base R | Convert column to a categorical factor | `factor(df$genre)` |
| `levels()` | base R | Show factor levels | `levels(df$genre)` |

## Counting and Summarizing

| Function | Package | What It Does | Example |
|----------|---------|-------------|---------|
| `count()` | tidyverse | Count rows by group | `df %>% count(genre, sort = TRUE)` |
| `group_by()` | tidyverse | Group data for per-group calculations | `df %>% group_by(genre)` |
| `summarize()` | tidyverse | Calculate summary statistics per group | `summarize(mean_val = mean(x))` |
| `ungroup()` | tidyverse | Remove grouping | `df %>% ungroup()` |
| `pivot_wider()` | tidyverse | Reshape long → wide | `pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = n)` |

## Visualization (ggplot2)

| Function | What It Does | Example |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `ggplot()` | Initialize a plot | `ggplot(df, aes(x = genre))` |
| `aes()` | Map variables to visual properties | `aes(x = genre, fill = mode)` |
| `geom_col()` | Bar chart (from pre-counted data) | `+ geom_col()` |
| `geom_bar()` | Bar chart (counts from raw data) | `+ geom_bar()` |
| `geom_boxplot()` | Boxplot | `+ geom_boxplot()` |
| `geom_text()` | Add text labels to a plot | `+ geom_text(aes(label = n))` |
| `coord_flip()` | Flip x and y axes (horizontal bars) | `+ coord_flip()` |
| `fct_reorder()` | Sort factor levels by a variable | `fct_reorder(genre, n)` |
| `fct_infreq()` | Sort factor levels by frequency | `fct_infreq(genre)` |
| `scale_fill_brewer()` | Colorblind-friendly color palette | `+ scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")` |
| `labs()` | Add title, subtitle, axis labels, caption | `+ labs(title = "My Chart")` |
| `theme_minimal()` | Clean, minimal chart theme | `+ theme_minimal()` |
| `v2v::theme_v2v()` | The course chart theme | `+ v2v::theme_v2v()` |
| `v2v::scale_fill_v2v()` | The course fill palette (up to 8 colors) | `+ v2v::scale_fill_v2v()` |
| `ggsave()` | Save the last chart to a file | `ggsave("figures/fig1.png", width = 7, height = 5)` |

## Statistical Testing

| Function | Package | What It Does | Example |
|----------|---------|-------------|---------|
| `table()` | base R | Build a contingency table | `table(df$var1, df$var2)` |
| `prop.table()` | base R | Convert counts to proportions | `prop.table(tbl, margin = 1)` |
| `chisq.test()` | base R | Chi-square test of independence | `chisq.test(tbl)` |
| `$statistic` | n/a | Extract χ² value from test result | `result$statistic` |
| `$parameter` | n/a | Extract degrees of freedom | `result$parameter` |
| `$p.value` | n/a | Extract p-value | `result$p.value` |
| `$stdres` | n/a | Extract standardized residuals | `result$stdres` |
| `xtabs()` | base R | Build a contingency table from a formula | `xtabs(~ cat_a + cat_b, data = df)` |
| `broom::tidy()` | broom | Turn a test or model result into a one-row-per-term table | `t.test(y ~ g, data = df) %>% broom::tidy()` |
| `broom::glance()` | broom | One row of model-level numbers, including `nobs` | `fit %>% broom::glance()` |
| `t.test()` | base R | Welch t-test of a numeric outcome across two groups | `t.test(y ~ g, data = df)` |
| `effectsize::cohens_d()` | effectsize | Cohen's d with its interval | `effectsize::cohens_d(y ~ g, data = df)` |
| `effectsize::cramers_v()` | effectsize | Cramér's V for a contingency table | `effectsize::cramers_v(tbl, adjust = FALSE)` |
| `aov()` | base R | One-way ANOVA, then `summary()` for the F table | `summary(aov(y ~ g3, data = df))` |
| `lm()` | base R | Linear regression, then `summary()` for the coefficients | `summary(lm(y ~ x, data = df))` |
| `cor.test()` | base R | Pearson correlation with its interval | `cor.test(~ x + y, data = df)` |
| `v2v::run_chi_square()` | v2v | The chi-square test and Cramér's V in one labeled block (a check on the lines above) | `v2v::run_chi_square(df, x = cat_a, y = cat_b)` |
| `v2v::run_t_test()` | v2v | The Welch t-test and Cohen's d in one labeled block (a check) | `v2v::run_t_test(df, value = y, group = g)` |

## Exporting Data

| Function | What It Does | Example |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `write_rds()` | Save data as .RDS (preserves factors and date-times) | `write_rds(df, "clean.RDS")` |
| `write_csv()` | Save data as CSV | `write_csv(df, "output.csv")` |

## Publishing (Quarto)

| Command | What It Does |
|---------|-------------|
| `quarto render` | Render all chapters into PDF + HTML |
| `knitr::kable()` | Format a data frame as a publication-ready table |
| `@citationkey` | Insert an in-text citation from `references.bib` |

## The Pipe: `%>%`

The pipe passes the result from the left to the first argument of the function on the right:

```r
clean_names(read_csv("data.csv"))

read_csv("data.csv") %>% clean_names()

chat %>%
  filter(!is.na(is_gaming)) %>%
  count(channel, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100)
```

Read `%>%` as **"and then."**
